name: Cleansing Hall
description: The hall's entry and exit seal with a force barrier, then waves of force surge through the hall.
disable: DC 48 Thievery (master) to deface the script without triggering, DC 47 Arcana (master) to redirect the magical energy, or DC 46 Religion (master) to quote Pharasmin prayers
reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
routine: (1 action) A wave of force flows down the hall from north to south, dealing (3d10+20) Force Damage damage to each creature in the corridor. Each creature must attempt a Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw. On a failure, a creature is pushed back 5 feet (10 feet on a critical failure). If this movement would cause a creature to hit another creature, both creatures take 1d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage. If this movement would cause a creature to hit a force barrier, the creature takes 2d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage. Animals, plants, and worshippers of Pharasma are immune to this force damage.

generalAbilities.name: Force Barrier
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature reaches the hall's midpoint

Effect Force barriers seal the hall's entrance and exit for 1 minute. The trap then rolls initiative.
